findings.summary: Recorded finite sentinel, FP32 device scales, offset/output FMA, four FP16 chains and tiny sequential FMA; removed unconditional rounding, saturation and exactness guarantees.
Added probability/correction register copies; specified segmented addresses, packing, CTA units and reserved bytes; corrected 32-row rescale quantity and 40 KiB K/V depth delta.
Named the existing final CTA join and role-exit dependencies; retained valid early output-source release; corrected one-time q_loaded init, queue lane and sentinel publication.
Removed head-major tiny-reread hazard and unnecessary source-fix recommendation; tail PV waits for row_final -> p_ready before any following-unit QK or V-slot reuse.

Documented metadata readiness, prior-call completion, no concurrent host entry and stable device because shared static staging/table/queue lack a reverse side-stream join. Contract input domain unchanged.

Closed K3/static-grid changes against new storage/join entries, kept MODE1 unreachable, and separated CPU/copy preparation, kernel-sum timing, source certificates and unknown external comparator definitions.

All 29 Input and both Output entries preserved. Whole-tuple versus four-int logic, defaults, nullable branches and shape_range equality/head set independently confirmed; defaults do not imply singleton ranges.
